summary: Tested Resend email integration, Xirsys TURN server integration, and Virtual Background with TensorFlow.js BodyPix. All 14 backend tests passed. Frontend Virtual Background selector verified with blur and image options.

minor.issue: Missing null check for user in endpoints - FIXED by adding authentication validation

critical_code_review_comments: Email service properly falls back to mock mode when RESEND_API_KEY is not set
TURN service properly falls back to Google STUN servers when Xirsys credentials are not set
Virtual Background selector loads BodyPix model dynamically and shows blur/image options
Frontend fetches ICE servers from backend on component mount
MeetingRoom uses dynamically fetched ICE servers for WebRTC configuration
context_for_next_testing_agent: Resend email and Xirsys TURN integrations are working in mock/fallback mode. Virtual Background selector shows blur and image options with BodyPix model loading. WebGL errors in headless browser are expected - TensorFlow.js requires WebGL which isn't available in headless mode.

notes: To enable real emails: Add RESEND_API_KEY to backend/.env. To enable TURN: Add XIRSYS_IDENT, XIRSYS_SECRET, XIRSYS_CHANNEL to backend/.env. Virtual background requires WebGL which is not available in headless browser testing.
